The rest of the world has the same rich variety they have had for decades; if you want to see what shortwave sounds like as received in Europe, go to http://websdr.ewi.utwente.nl:8901/ -- this is a software-defined shortwave radio in the Netherlands.

Using it is fairly simple:

-- Click somewhere on the waterfall where the stations are clustered (the yellow lines are signals being received);

-- Click on "band" to zoom in on the display;

-- Click on "AM" to put the receiver in AM mode;

-- Use the --- and +++ buttons to change the frequency up and down.

To change bands, click on "max out" and start over again.

edit: There may not be quite so much activity going on at this particular moment, as there is a massive solar flareup and conditions are not too good on the shortwave bands as a result.
